name: Vaspör (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vaspör (a blue and red shield with a church, a bird and a bunch of grapes) above the name VASPÖR in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
